gloss: to tease; to make fun of; to kid

definitions.gloss: to tease; to make fun of; to kid
definitions.explanation: To playfully mock or joke with someone, often in a good-natured way but sometimes crossing into mean-spirited territory.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}をからかって{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: I was playing around teasing my friend.

examples.japanese: からかわないでよ、{本気|ほんき}なんだから。
examples.english: Don't tease me - I'm being serious!

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{新人|しんじん}をからかうのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: He likes to make fun of new employees.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). Takes を to mark the person being teased.

USAGE:
からかう ranges from playful teasing between friends to more malicious mocking. Context and tone determine whether it's friendly or unkind.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{人|ひと}をからかう (to tease someone)
・からかい{半分|はんぶん}に (half-jokingly)
・からかわれる (passive: to be teased)

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・いじる - to tease/poke fun at (often in comedy contexts)
・ふざける - to fool around/joke (focuses on the joking behavior itself)
・ひやかす - to tease/jeer (often about romantic interests)
・{冷|ひ}やかす - to make fun of, to jeer
